February 11, 2025 CITY COUNCIL MINUTES 7812 Consent Agenda (continued) 5. Promoting Resilient Operations for Transformative, Efficient, and Cost-Saving Transportation (PROTECT) Discretionary Grant Programs of the Department of Transportation Federal Highway Administration: Authorization for Application, Acceptance, and Appropriation of Grant Funds for the West Cliff Drive Coastal Resilience Project (CM/PW) LOCATION: District 6 Motion carried to  Adopt Resolution No. NS-30,436 authorizing the City Manager to apply for, accept, and execute all necessary applications, contracts and agreements and amendments thereto and appropriate funds from the PROTECT Discretionary Grant Program for a grant to implement the West Cliff Drive Coastal Resilience Project, and  Adopt Resolution No. NS-30,437 to amend the FY 2025 budget in the amount of $5,000,000 for the PROTECT Discretionary Grant. 6. Resolution Affirming Santa Cruz’s Commitment to Abide by the California Values Act and Reaffirming Prior Council Action Restricting the use of City Resources for Immigration Enforcement (CN) LOCATION: Citywide Motion carried to:  Adopt Resolution No. NS-30,438 affirming Santa Cruz’s commitment to abide by the California Values Act and reaffirming prior Council action restricting the use of City resources for immigration enforcement, and  Direct the City Manager’s Office to collaborate and communicate with other local government and non-profit partners who are committed to the State’s California Values Act and related policies of the State of California.
